feeds.title: I Help C
feeds.description: This blog's mission is to offer support, hope, information, and encouragement to those who are dealing with liver disease, cancer, or transplant from Hepatitis C and Cirrhosis.

feeds.title: Hep Magazine
feeds.description: Go-to online source for educational and social support for people living with hepatitis C/B/A and fatty liver diseases. Hep is devoted to combating the stigma and isolation surrounding hepatitis.

feeds.title: Hepatitis C Mentor & Support Group, Inc. Blog
feeds.description: The Hepatitis C Mentor and Support Group was founded to address the lack of education and supportive services for people living with Hepatitis C and Co-infection, HCV/HIV.

feeds.title: HCV New Drug Research
feeds.description: This blog links to patient friendly commentary about current HCV treatment options, using information extracted from news articles, peer-reviewed journals, liver meetings/conferences, and interactive learning activities.

feeds.title: Hepatitis Central News
feeds.description: The latest research & treatment news about Hepatitis C infection, diagnosis, transmission, symptoms and treatment.

feeds.title: The High-fat Hep C Diet Blog
feeds.description: Hepatitis C viraemia is carbohydrate-dependent because the virus piggy-backs on triglyceride assembly and VLDL exocytosis. This makes a very low carbohydrate diet an effective way to control HCV viraemia, HCV-associated autoimmune syndromes, and steatosis.

feeds.title: C Anything But Average - Five failed treatments won't stop me, Lets go ROUND SIX!
feeds.description: My journey with Hepatitis C, Incivek, Sovaldi, Olysio , Harvoni, decompensated liver, MELD 19 , Cirrhosis, Ascities, Varicies & Encephalopathy.

feeds.title: HCPLive » Hepatitis C
feeds.description: This section of the blog features articles, interviews, videos, podcasts, and breaking news on hepatitis C virus research, treatment, and drug development. HCPLive is a comprehensive clinical news and information portal that provides physicians with resources designed to help them provide better care to patients.

feeds.title: Hepatitis C Trust
feeds.description: The Hepatitis C Trust is the only UK charity for hepatitis C. For patients by patients. It is an entirely patient-led and patient-run organisation. The Trust's mission is to reverse the rapidly increasing death toll caused by hepatitis C in the UK until no-one dies from this preventable and treatable disease and, ultimately, it is all but eradicated in this country.

feeds.title: Generic Hepatitis C Medication Blog
feeds.description: This website was originally created to record my experiences after I discovered I was infected with Hepatitis C back in August 2014 and how I used generic Sovaldi from India as an effective and cheap Hepatitis C treatment. However, since then, my website has become focused more on helping people with Hepatitis C buy GILEAD licensed generic Hepatitis C medication online and also with supplying easy to understand information about Hepatitis C treatment and the effects of Hepatitis C.
